Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ১) Rahim is one ____ superstitious people I known.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Rahim is one of the most superstitious people I known. one of the এর পর সর্বদা superlative degree বসে। তাই much এর superlative degree most.

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ২) He reads how he wants. Here 'how he wants' is a/an ____ clause.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: যে dependent clause টি Adverb- এর মত কাজ করে অর্থাৎ স্থান, সময়, উদ্দেশ্য, পরিমাণ, ফলাফল, তুলনা, ধরণ, কারণ, বৈপরীত্য প্রকাশ করে তাকে Adverb clause বলে। আবার verb বা Adverb কে modify করে তাকে Adverb clause বলে। He reads how he wants. এখানে modifying verb read.

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৩) I remember the place where I was born. Here 'where I was born' is a/an ____ clause.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: যে Dependent clause টি Adjective এর মত ব্যবহৃত হয় তাকে adjective clause বলে। অর্থাৎ সংক্ষেপে Noun এর পর যদি কোন Clause বসে তাহলে সেটি Adjective clause হবে। এখানে place হচ্ছে Noun তাই এর পরের clause অবশ্যই Adjective clause হবে। Adjective clause এর অপর নাম Relative clause।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৪) Ponom bought a costly car. Here 'a costly car' is a/an -
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: বাক্যটিতে Ponom (subject), bought (verb), a costly car (object). এখানে a costly car একটি Phrase কেননা এটি a group of words নিয়ে গঠিত হয়েছে। এখানে কোন subject ও finite verb নেই এবং বাক্যে object হিসেবে অর্থাৎ একটি মাত্র parts of speech হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৫) 'Kobita has made tea' make it passive voice.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) Tea is being made by Kobita
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) Tea was being made by Kobita
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) Tea has been made by Kobita
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) Tea have been make by Kobita
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Present perfect Tense এর Active voice থেকে Passive voice করার নিয়ম: Object টি subjective form + have been/ has been + মূল verb এর past participle + by + subject এর objective form.

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৬) No examinee is permitted to leave the exam hall _____ the exam is in progress.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: বাক্যটিতে দুইটি Clause আছে। 1) No examinee is permitted to leave the exam hall. 2) the exam is in progress. এই দুইটি Clause কে একটা Conjunction দ্বারা যুক্ত করতে হবে। আর এই বাক্যের জন্য উপযুক্ত Conjunction হলো while. While যোগে বাক্যটি- No examinee is permitted to leave the exam hall while the exam is in progress. বাক্যটির অর্থ- পরীক্ষা চলমান অবস্থায় কোনও পরীক্ষার্থীর পরীক্ষার হল ছাড়ার অনুমতি নাই।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৭) Hospitable people like speaking to foreigners _______ they have not been introduced.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: কোন কিছু ঘটা সত্ত্বেও অন্য পরিস্থিতি একই থাকে সেক্ষেত্রে যদিও/তবুও অর্থে even if ব্যবহৃত হয়। Hospitable people like speaking to foreigners even if they have not been introduced.

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৮) _________ Bangladesh has many new growth sectors, foreign investors are coming here in great numbers.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Because- কারণ, সে-কারণে, কেননা, যেহেতু।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৯) Can you give me ______ information about places of interest in the town.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Information uncountable noun, তাই determiner হিসেবে এর পূর্বে some বসবে। উল্লেখ্য, বাক্যের অর্থ এবং গঠন অনুসারে some countable/uncountable উভয় ধরণের noun এর পূর্বে বসতে পারে।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ১০) To lead a well balanced life, you need to have other interests _______ studying.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Besides: in addition to; also. She won't mind if you're late - besides, it's hardly your fault. Do you play any other sports besides basketball?

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ১১) Change the narration: Her friend said to her, ''Can you spare your book for me a week?''
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) Her friend asked her if she could spare the book for her for a week.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) Her friend said her whether she could spare her book for a week.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) Her friend requested her to spare the book for her for a week.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) Her friend asked her to spare the book for her for a week.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: No explanation added.

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ১২) Change the narration, He remarked, ''Two and two makes four.''
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) He remarked that two and two would make four.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) He remarked that two and two made four.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) He remarked that two and two makes four.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) He advised that two and two makes four.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Reported speech কোনো চিরন্তন সত্য বা অভ্যাসগত কর্ম বা ঐতিহাসিক সত্য বা বৈজ্ঞানিক সত্য প্রকাশ করলে Indirect Narration এ Tense এর কোনো পরিবর্তন হয় না৷

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ১৩) Zabir said ''I must write a letter.''- Change the narration:
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) Zabir said that he might write a letter.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) Zabir told that he should write a letter.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) Zabir told that he must write a letter.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) Zabir said that he had to write a letter.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Direct speech এ must থাকলে Indirect speech এ had to হয়।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ১৪) The chairman _________ as though I had not spoken.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: As though/as if এর পরে past perfect tense থাকলে, পূর্বে অবশ্যই past indefinite tense ব্যবহার করতে হবে।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ১৫) Hardly had we reached school ____________.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Negative word + Auxiliary verb + Subject + main verb + extension. No sooner had ….. than, scarcely had …….. when, hardly had …….. before এর প্রথম অংশ Past Perfect and Verb এর Past Participle হয় এবং ২য় অংশে Past Indefinite হয়। উল্লেখ্য, no sooner.......than, scarcely......when, hardly........ when আসে- এ বিষয়টি মাথায় রাখতে হবে।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ১৬) If I would have realised the nature of the job earlier, I would not have accepted it.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) In case I would have
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: অতীতের কোন অপূরণীয় ইচ্ছা/আকাঙ্খা প্রকাশ করতে main clause এ যদি would have + v3 ব্যবহৃত হয়, তবে subordinate clause টি If+ sub + would have + v3 অথবা Had + sub + v3 হয়।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ১৭) Select the correct passive voice of ‘I knew him’.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) He is known to me.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) He is known by me.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) He was known to me.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) He was known by me.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Passive voice এ know এর পরে by না বসে to বসে।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ১৮) Give the order. (Passive voice)
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) Let the order to give
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) Let the order to given
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) Let the order be given
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: An imperative sentence in the passive voice has the following form: Let + object + be + past participle.

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ১৯) The Padma is one of the biggest rivers in Bangladesh. (Positive)
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) Very few river in Bangladesh is as big as the Padma.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) Very few rivers in Bangladesh are as big as the Padma.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) No other river in Bangladesh is as big as the Padma.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) No other rivers in Bangladesh is as big as the Padma.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Superlative degree তে one of the থাকলে Positive degree তে very few হয়। Very few + plural noun + plural verb + as + positive degree + as + subject.

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ২০) Whom did she accuse? (Passive voice)
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) Who had been accused by her?
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) Who was accused by her?
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) Who was being accused by her?
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) By whom was she accused?
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Structure: Who + be verb + past participle form of verb + by + objective form of subject.

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ২১) The Passive from of the sentence. 'We made her recite a poem'-
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) a poem was made recite by her
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) she was made to recite a poem
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) she was made recited a poem
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) a poem was made to be recited
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Make, help, see ইত্যাদি verb সমূহের ক্ষেত্রে Active Voice এ এদের পরে Infinitive ‘to’ বসে না। কিন্তু Passive এ রূপান্তর করতে গেলে বাক্যের পরের verb টির পূর্বে ‘to’ infinitive বসাতে হয়।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ২২) Identify the correct passive form of the sentence. ‘Do you see the flower?’
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) Is the flower seen by you
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) Is the flower was seen by you?
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) Is the flower being seen by you?
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) Is the flower seen by you?
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Am/is/are + obj কে sub + verb এর P.P + by + sub কে obj + question mark. অপশন ’ক’ তে প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন নাই, তাই উত্তর অপশন ‘ঘ’।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ২৩) The future of the planet doesn't look too good, but there isn’t much __
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) I can make about it
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) I can do about it
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) can I do about it
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) I can’t do about it
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Do about something অর্থ কোনো কিছুর সাথে পেরে উঠার জন্য পদক্ষেপ নেয়া। আর but- এর পর negative বাক্য থাকার এর পরের অংশটি positive statement হবে। সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর “I can do about it”.

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ২৪) The mother would not eat until she had feed all her children.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Until-এর পরের clause এ had+verb এর p.p থাকার কথা থাকলেও verb এর present from ব্যাবহার করা হয়েছে। সুতরাং feed এর স্থলে feed এর p.p fed বসালে বাক্যটি right হবে।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ২৫) The view of these disciplines _____ time to time.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Sub (singular) + prepositional phrase + verb (singular). The view (singular subject) of these disciplines (prepositional phrase) varies from (singular verb) time to time.

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ২৬) Which one is incorrect?
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) Each girl needs proper knowledge about nutrition.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) Every girl needs proper knowledge about nutrition.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) Every of the girls needs proper knowledge about nutrition.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) Each of the girls needs proper knowledge about nutrition.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: বাক্যে each/every থাকলে singular noun এর সাথে singular verb হয়। Each of থাকলে plural noun এর সাথে singular verb হয়।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ২৭) There is ___ dust on these books.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: some, a lot of হয় countable/uncountable noun এর ক্ষেত্রে। যেমনঃ a lot of dust, a lot of books, some coffee, some books। lots of হয় countable plural noun এর ক্ষেত্রে। যেমনঃ lots of books।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ২৮) This is the projector that our class used. Here 'that our class used' is-
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Adjective clause এর আগে/পরে/কাছাকাছি noun/pronoun থাকবে। এবং তা noun/pronoun কে modify(make partial or minor changes) করবে। এখানে “that our class used” clause টি noun “ the projector” কে modify করে।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ২৯) I shall come when he will come. Here 'when he will come' is-
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: এখানে, “when he will come” principal clause এর “come” verb কে modify(make partial or minor changes) করে। তাই এটি Adverbial clause. কিন্তু যদি Sentence টি এমন হতো 'I know when he will come'. তবে “when he will come” Noun clause হতো। কেননা তা “know” verb কে modify করে না।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৩০) Which one of the following is a simple sentence?
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) He is poor but honest
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) Though he is poor, he is honest
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) In spite of his poverty, he is honest
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) He is poor and honest
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: একটি simple sentence এ শুধুমাত্র একটি clause থাকে অর্থাৎ একটি subject এবং একটি finite verb থাকে, এছাড়া simple sentence সাধারণত In spite of, Despite,Because of ইত্যাদি থাকে।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৩১) Though he is poor, he is happy.( make it simple)
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) Despite his poverty, he is happy.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) In spite of his being poor, he is unhappy
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) He is poor but happy
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) In spite of his poorness, he is happy
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Complex sentence এ though / although থাকলে simple sentence এ inspite of/ despite ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৩২) He did not study hard;_____he passed the examination.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: nevertheless/nonetheless একই অর্থ প্রকাশ করে।এর অর্থ হল তারপরেও/তবুও। খারাপ কিছু হওয়ার সম্ভাবনা ছিল কিন্তু ঘটেনি এরূপ বুঝাতে nevertheless হয়।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৩৩) Ten years have passed since I met you last. Here ‘since’ is-
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: কিছু কিছু word আছে যারা ব্যবহার ভেদে preposition বা conjunction হতে পারে।যেমন- He stood ‘before’ me.(preposition} The patient had died ‘before’ the doctor came.(conjunction} It has been raining ‘since’ morning.(preposition) এছাড়াও compound sentence এর মাঝে conjunction বসে।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৩৪) He has paid the penalty_____his crimes_____five years in prison.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: penalty for/with-পুরস্কার বা শাস্তি প্রদান করা এবং five years এর আগে with বসানো যায়।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৩৫) The doctor suggested that the patient _____ weight.
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Demand, insist, suggest, urge, request etc. এই verb গুলোর পর that থাকলে, that claus এর verb টি present form হয় এবং তার সাথে s, es, ies, ing যুক্ত হয়না।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৩৬) Bring me the floating flower. Here ‘floating’ is-
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: It’s a present participle. যে সকল শব্দ একই সাথে verb & adjective এর কাজ করে সেই সকল শব্দকে participle বলে।

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৩৭) They organized a volunteer corps. Here “corps” is which kind of noun?
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: ছোট ছোট দলে বিভক্ত হয়ে গেলে তাদেরকে Corps বলে। তাই, এটা collective noun

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৩৮) The day of my sister’s marriage is drawing ‘near’. The quoted ward is a/an -
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: Here ‘near’ is modifying ‘the day’ which is an adverb of time.

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৩৯) অধিক সন্ন্যাসীতে গাজন নষ্ট। প্রবাদটির ইংরেজি হবে-
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) Too many cooks spoil the broth
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option3: গ) Too many saints spoil the broth
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option4: ঘ) As many cooks spoil the broth
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: No explanation added.

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৪০) অজ্ঞতা অন্ধকারের শামিল। ইংরেজি অনুবাদ-
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.exp: No explanation added.

Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.question: ৪১) The boy takes after his father. বাংলা অনুবাদ-
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option1: ক) ছেলেটি তার পিতার ওপর ক্ষিপ্ত
Tanslation & Proverbs, Voice, Narration.option2: খ) ছেলেটি তার পিতাকে অনুসরণ করে থাকে
